body:
Closes #212

### What
Adds share buttons to the Commitment Details view when status is `FULFILLED`.

- Users can share on X (Twitter) with a pre-filled tweet intent.
- Users can share on Farcaster with a pre-filled cast intent.
- Includes `aria-label` for accessibility and `rel="noopener noreferrer"` for security.

### Notes
The Reputation Dashboard is a Module-Federation remote widget loaded at runtime, so adding share buttons there requires a separate PR in the `frontend-dashboard-remote` package. This PR covers the host-app CommitmentItem only.
title: feat(frontend): add Share to X/Farcaster buttons for fulfilled commitments (#212)
